commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
p = json.loads(Path(\"project/recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
s = p[\"retained_sample\"]
b = bytes.fromhex(s[\"value_hex\"])
pos = 5

def read_long():
    global pos
    value = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        part = b[pos]
        pos += 1
        value |= (part & 0x7f) << shift
        if not part & 0x80:
            return (value >> 1) "'^ -(value & 1)
        shift += 7

def read_string():
    global pos
    length = read_long()
    assert length >= 0
    result = b[pos:pos+length].decode("utf-8")
    pos += length
    return result

account = read_string()
currency = read_string()
amount = read_long()
ledger = s["source_ledger"]
assert b[0] == 0
assert int.from_bytes(b[1:5], "big") == s["source_writer_id"] == 42
assert pos == len(b)
assert (account, currency, amount) == (ledger["account"], ledger["currency"], ledger["amount_minor"])
assert Decimal(amount) / 100 == Decimal(ledger["amount_decimal"])
print(json.dumps({
    "check": "offline byte arithmetic using supplied source writer schema; no registry or client executed",
    "wire_bytes": len(b),
    "magic": b[0],
    "writer_id_big_endian": int.from_bytes(b[1:5], "big"),
    "account": account,
    "currency": currency,
    "writer_amount_cents": amount,
    "source_amount_usd": format(Decimal(amount) / 100, ".2f"),
    "bytes_consumed": pos,
    "matches_supplied_ledger": True,
    "if_amount_were_misinterpreted_as_micro_usd": format(Decimal(amount) / 1000000, ".6f"),
    "equivalent_amount_in_micro_usd": amount * 10000,
    "archive_record_count_supplied": p["business_topic_check"]["restored_records"],
    "available_raw_record_samples": 1
}, indent=2))'"'"
